units.source_text: 我还在他的房间里发现了《圣经》，

en.t: I also found a Bible in his room,

units.source_text: 有点惊讶。记得以前常常听他说起一些佛经的名称，但是关于基督教，他从没有问过我，也没有回答过我什么。

en.t: I was a little surprised. I remembered often hearing him mention the names of Buddhist scriptures before, but as for Christianity, he had never asked me anything about it, nor had I ever answered him anything.

units.source_text: 我禁不住问他为什么看这书，

en.t: I could not help asking him why he was reading that book,

units.source_text: 他说不为什么，只是说，既然是这么多人爱看的书，当然想读读啦。

en.t: He said there was no particular reason, only that since it was a book so many people liked to read, naturally he wanted to read it too.

units.source_text: 而且他还说，如果有机会还想看看《古兰经》呢。

en.t: Moreover, he said that if he had the chance, he would like to read the Quran as well.

units.source_text: 他好像对‘穆罕默德’和‘剑’这些词也颇有兴趣。

en.t: He also seemed quite interested in words such as Muhammad and sword.

units.source_text: 第二年的暑假，由于家里来信催他，他才回去了。

en.t: During the summer vacation of the following year, he finally went home because his family wrote urging him to return.

units.source_text: 不过，回去以后他好像也没对家人提及专业的事，而家人也没有问。

en.t: However, even after he returned home, it seems he did not mention his field of study to his family, and they did not ask either.

units.source_text: 你是个受过学校教育的人，这类事情是可以理解的，然而一般人对于学生生活和学校规章都惊人地无知。

en.t: You are someone who has had a school education, so you can understand such things, but ordinary people are astonishingly ignorant about student life and school rules.

units.source_text: 我们一般不会将无关紧要的事情对外人讲，

en.t: We generally do not tell outsiders about matters of no importance,

units.source_text: 而我们这些学生整天呼吸的又都是校园内的空气，总是喜欢多想，以为学校里的事情，不论大小都会传到外面去。

en.t: while we students, breathing the air inside the school all day long, tend to think too much and imagine that everything at school, large or small, will be known outside.

units.source_text: 在这方面，K也许比我更老练吧，他又若无其事地回来了。

en.t: In this respect, K was perhaps more worldly than I was; he came back again as if nothing had happened.

units.source_text: 我是和他一起回东京的。

en.t: I returned to Tokyo together with him.

units.source_text: 一上火车，我就问他家里说什么了，他回答没说什么。

en.t: As soon as we got on the train, I asked him what his family had said, and he answered that they had said nothing.
